Planning Document: Setback Requirements

Clause 3.1: Front setbacks must be minimum 6 metres from the street boundary.
Clause 3.2: Side setbacks must be minimum 1.5 metres on each side.
Clause 3.3: Rear setbacks must be minimum 6 metres from the rear boundary.
Clause 3.4: Setbacks may be reduced for heritage buildings with Council approval.
